notDue.title: The handover date has not come
notDue.body: You can accept from the handover date the developer set. Review the details in the meantime.

unitOwned.title: A unit already has owners in the register
unitOwned.body: A unit in this payload matches a unit that already has current owners, so nothing was recorded. Check the co-owner register, or reject so the developer sends a corrected one.

totalsMismatch.title: The recorded totals differ from the payload
totalsMismatch.body: Nothing was recorded because the totals to record do not equal what the developer sent. Reject with a reason so the developer checks and sends it again.

invalid.title: The payload still has problems
invalid.body: The developer must fix the problems on this page before it can be accepted. Reject and list what to fix.

invalidState.title: The state has changed
invalidState.body: Someone acted on this handover in the meantime. Reload to see where it stands.

sharesExceeded.title: Shares over 100%
sharesExceeded.body: With the existing register, some units' owners hold more than 100%. Reject so the developer fixes it.

accept.title: Accept {building}
accept.body: Records {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}, {owners, plural, one {# owner} other {# owners}} and the money sent in one go; {invoices, plural, one {# opening balance is} other {# opening balances are}} issued at once.
accept.legalFormNeeded: The developer did not send the building's legal form. Choose it before accepting.

effect.register: The building, floors, units, co-owners and their shares are created
effect.credits: Advance common fees become each owner's credit, paying the next invoices — never set against debt brought forward
effect.fund: First fund contributions go to the building's sinking fund
effect.opening: Receivables brought forward are issued as opening balances with the normal due date

accept.legalFormHint: Only when the developer did not send it
accept.legalFormRequired: Required: the developer did not send it
accept.kindHint: Optional: the building type sent is used
accept.notify: Send opening balances to their owners
accept.notifyOn: Owners receive their opening balance like a new invoice
accept.notifyOff: Opening balances are issued without telling the owners

reject.title: Reject {building}
reject.body: Nothing is recorded. The reason goes back to the developer through getbuild so they can fix it and send it again.
reject.done: Rejected — the reason goes to the developer
reject.reasonHint: 5–1000 characters; say clearly what to fix

formed.title: Registration of the juristic person — {building}
formed.bodyDeveloper: Once recorded, the developer stops operating the building and the juristic office takes over. Residents, invoices and credits stay with the building.
formed.body: Record the registration date and number. This is recorded once.

error.future: The date cannot be after today ({date})
error.already: The registration was already recorded. Reload the page.

list.title: Developer handovers
list.lede: Buildings developers hand over through getbuild, with the co-owner register and the money the office takes over

pending.title: Nothing awaiting review
pending.body: When a developer hands a building over, it arrives here with the money to take over.

accepted.title: No accepted handovers yet
accepted.body: Accepted buildings appear here with what was recorded.

rejected.title: No rejected handovers
rejected.body: Rejected handovers appear here with their reason.

all.title: No developer handovers yet
all.body: When a developer hands a building over through getbuild, the co-owner register, advance common fees, fund contributions and debt brought forward arrive here for review.

empty.toImport: Import from a legacy system instead

list.register: {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} · {owners, plural, one {# owner} other {# owners}}

review.title: Handover of {building}

figure.label: What was sent
figure.advanceHint: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} with money
figure.unitsHint: {floors, plural, one {# floor} other {# floors}} · {owners, plural, one {# owner} other {# owners}}

reason.problems: The developer must fix {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} first

title.formed: The juristic office has taken over

body.pending: Accepting records everything in one go:
body.developerOperates: The developer operates the building until the juristic person is registered. Record the registration when you receive the certificate.
body.accepted: The register and the money are recorded. Record the juristic person's registration when you receive the certificate.
body.rejectedDelivered: The reason reached the developer on {date}. They may send a corrected handover.
body.rejectedWaiting: Sending the reason back to the developer; it is retried until delivered.
body.superseded: The developer sent a newer handover. Review the latest one.

effect.register: The building, its units and co-owners
effect.credits: Advance common fees as owners' credit
effect.fund: First fund contributions into the sinking fund
effect.opening: Debt brought forward issued as opening balances

panel.readOnly: You can review the details; the office manager accepts or rejects.

review.registerOnly: This handover carries the co-owner register only, no money. Debt and fund balances can be imported later from Data import.
review.privacy: Contact details the developer sends encrypted are not kept. Owners link their own account through LINE later.

problems.title: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} for the developer to fix
problems.lede: The handover can be accepted once none remain. Reject and list them; the developer sends a corrected one.

code.owner_missing: This unit holds money but has no owner
code.party_unknown: Refers to an owner who is not in the list sent
code.unit_unknown: Refers to a unit that is not in the register sent
code.floor_unknown: Refers to a floor the building does not have
code.shares_exceeded: The owners' shares add up to more than 100%
code.duplicate_unit_no: The unit number appears twice in the same payload
code.receivable_after_as_of: A receivable is dated after the as-of date

bank.title: Receiving account
bank.lede: Where the developer transfers the advance fees and fund money, beside the juristic office's own accounts
bank.none: No receiving account: this handover carries no money.
bank.noMatch: No account with the same bank and last four digits yet
bank.matched: Matches the office's account — entries post to it
bank.unmatched: No matching account — entries post to the office's main bank account instead

owners.title: Co-owners
owners.rule: No duplicates: an owner with the same LINE account, or from an earlier handover of the same developer, joins the existing record.

applied.title: What was recorded
applied.opening: {count, plural, one {# opening balance} other {# opening balances}}
